This isn't a wellness class.
It's a return.

Imagine lying on open water as the sun sets over Vancouver. The city softens. Your body lets go. And then — sound. Crystal bowls. Frequencies that move through the water, through the mat, through you.

You don't need to do anything. You don't need to try. You just need to arrive, lie down, and let the water and sound do what they've always known how to do.

Last summer, 200 people floated with us. This summer, we're opening the water to more — without changing what makes it work. Each session stays small, held, intimate by design.

Summer 2024 · Vancouver

The experience

What the water
holds for you

01

Sound in the body

Crystal bowls and frequencies that don't just enter through the ears — they move through the water, through the mat, into the tissue. You feel it before you think it.

02

Water as medicine

Open water changes the nervous system in ways a room cannot. The gentle movement, the open sky — your body knows it's safe to fully let go.

03

Small by design

Each session holds 20–25 people. Not because we can't scale — but because the experience only works when everyone is truly held. You will not be lost in a crowd.

The sound comes
from the earth.
It returns to the body.

Crystal bowls. Tibetan bowls. Soundscapes layered with intention. Each session is played live — not recorded, not repeated. The sound you hear that evening will never exist again exactly that way.

Komal has been facilitating immersive sound experiences since 2023, creating spaces where deep rest isn't something you have to try for — it simply arrives.
